name: Swiss Club Singapore
summary: Swiss–European hillside club with dining, events, and holiday camps often open beyond full members — a Bukit Timah soft-landing alternative to Orchard mega-clubs.
body: Swiss Club anchors Swiss and broader European social life with F&B, events, sport facilities, and family programming on a Bukit Timah hillside footprint. Forum parents hunting outdoor or club-run holiday camps frequently name Swiss Club alongside American Club calendars — some seasons offer limited public or guest-access camp seats, so verify the live brochure rather than assuming members-only. Membership interest often tracks Swiss and European corporate postings; categories may favour Swiss links. Tour for culture fit: it is community-first as much as facilities-first, and the commute maths only work if your housing and school already sit west/central. Compare cost-per-use against Hollandse Club, American Club, and ActiveSG before paying entrance fees.
membershipNotes: Categories may favour Swiss links — ask membership office about entrance fees, monthly dues, guest rules, and school-break camp calendars (member priority vs limited public seats).
